results.rationale: Consistency: upper A-B-C and D/F branches remain, but E and G are also deleted and the B-E edge is left dangling. Instruction: removal of the entire E/G/H subtree fails to leave G without siblings because G itself is gone. Knowledge: H alone should be removed; instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: readable nodes but an obvious dangling branch makes the diagram structurally incomplete.

Consistency: supplied picture clues remain in their cells, but thick subgrid boundaries are lost. Instruction: every blank is populated, yet repeated butterflies and suns across rows prevent a correct solution. Knowledge: multiple duplicates violate the one-of-each row/column logic of the supplied picture grid. Quality: clear grid and mostly legible icons, with several distorted butterfly/animal symbols and inconsistent sun designs.
